basis: Degraded tetracycline causes proximal renal tubular dysfunction, producing acquired Fanconi syndrome.

Benign smooth-muscle neoplasm localized to the orbit; vascular origin does not establish broader cardiovascular involvement.
Classified as a chronic neurological pain disorder; vulvar location alone supplies no reproductive axis.
Fusion of dental cementum to alveolar bone prevents tooth eruption and movement; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia and sensorineural hearing impairment define the disorder; both documented in 3/3 patients. Proptosis alone does not establish ocular damage.
Malignancy of the uterine corpus or cervix; reproductive organs have no axis.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with globozoospermia and male infertility; no endocrine dysfunction established.
Sperm flagellar defects cause male infertility; no disease of an included organ or endocrine function is established.
Inflammatory bladder injury with hematuria; bleeding does not itself establish a hematologic disorder, and infection is not universal.
Ear, coloboma and cranial nerve/developmental defects define syndrome; hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 80-99%. Choanal and cardiac defects omitted at cap.
Paralysis-related ocular motility disorder; an underlying cranial neuropathy is not established across the entire concept.
Alpha-1-antitrypsin Pittsburgh has abnormal anticoagulant activity, causing a coagulation disorder; ordinary alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency organ effects do not apply.
Sensory/autonomic neuropathy; alacrima 80-99%, corneal erosion and scoliosis each 30-79%. BP lability alone does not establish vascular damage; renal disease is occasional.
Renal failure and microcephaly/myelination defects define Galloway-Mowat syndrome; congenital hypothyroidism occurs in 3/3 patients. Arachnodactyly alone adds no axis.
Adenocarcinoma arising in the endometrium, a reproductive tissue outside the axes.
Anorectal inflammation, usually infectious or associated with immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; radiation-induced cases are a subtype.
Sensorineural hearing loss in 5/5. Myopia in 3/5 is not established as direct disease-related ocular damage; ancestry specifies nonsyndromic hearing loss.
Congenital absence of the left brachiocephalic vein is a structural vascular anomaly, even when asymptomatic.
Carotidynia is classified here as a carotid artery disorder; facial pain alone does not establish brain or peripheral nerve damage.
Immune-mediated follicular inflammation destroys hair follicles and causes scarring alopecia. Associated oral lichen planus is a separate manifestation, not universal.
Skin laxity, emphysema and vascular defects define ARCL1; joint subluxation/pathologic fractures occur in 30-79%. GI and urinary diverticula are occasional.
Germ-cell malignancy arising in the testis as a reproductive organ; endocrine disease is not established.
Cerebral vascular hemorrhage directly injures brain tissue; bleeding alone does not imply a coagulation or blood-cell disorder.
Mitochondrial lipid-metabolism disorder defined by encephalopathy and deafness; hepatic failure occurs in 30-79%. Optic atrophy and scoliosis are occasional.
